name: civ_assets
description: C1 demonstration (Checkpoint C, 'operates a productive asset'): the band_6x20 population (six factions of 20 founding adults on foraging, stage 3 AI, sandbox) with Civ.Enabled = 1. People who carry a log they gathered may found a field, a workshop or a store at a free plot, build it from real logs, work it (the output belongs to the asset's owner) and haul logs to their workshop. Nothing scripted. 10 sim days.
